text: XX/XX/XXXX ProCollect called my mobile while I was in the waiting room of a hospital for my mother. PC asserted a debt of {$4100.00}. Did not describe the debt other than to identify the creditor as XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX. I asked for more information, but PC would only demand that I make payment, and threatened consequences. I ended call saying not to call me again, and to send any communication in writing. First week of XX/XX/XXXX Credit bureaus report that my credit score was dropping substantially because of a collections report. No additional information in the credit report beyond PC name and XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX. I disputed with the two bureaus that would allow dispute, but they denied dispute. XXXX would not allow dispute without more information, but no such information had been disclosed in PC demand or any credit report about the collections claim. XX/XX/XXXX PC sent letter, addressed to XXXX XXXX, asserting same claim with no additional information. I received letter around XXXX. I responded with a letter XX/XX/XXXX demanding documentation that supports PC 's belief that I owe debt. XX/XX/XXXX letter from PC, received XX/XX/XXXX. Provided hilariously inadequate documentation of debt. If it was in fact evidence of some debt, it was against one of two other people, who live 3000 miles away from me. We only shared a first name in common. I replied with the attached letter.

meta.issue: Attempts to collect debt not owed
